keyFindings.description: tellArchitect sets reported = true after the await unconditionally (:270). A tool call or delivery during the publish resets the run (count 0, reportKey cleared) and the next run's continuation brings count to 1; the late acknowledgement then marks the new run reported, so its architect notice is never sent (deep-review probe: count 1 reported true, no second publish at count 2). Set reported only when reportKey is still the key this publish was sent under.

sendReminder discards the inbox promise (:327). When the bridge's inbox refuses or the socket drops, the runner has already counted the reminder and used its one-shot timer, and nothing re-arms it: no turn starts, so no Stop arrives. The endless reminder stops silently, the failure this issue exists to end. A failed write must re-arm a generation-guarded reminder.

Under session_store postgres the issue pod's LEGION_EXPECT_ISSUE_VOLUME is decided by the launch that makes the pod (:94, :236). When an Oh My Pi role makes it after a volume loss, the retained-session lookup is skipped, workspace-init provisions fresh, and the Claude sibling's resume then fails in internal/launcher's sessionWritten (stat of the missing transcript) as a plain launch failure until its budget ends, never the WorkspaceLost relaunch.

The other ordering: a Claude resume now makes the lost-volume exit reachable under postgres (:94). Its WorkspaceLost reaches supervise relaunchFresh -> VolumeLost -> sessionLost (supervise/table.go:991) for every processless or booting sibling, which drops Oh My Pi sessions that are intact in the session table and relaunches them fresh.
A publish failure other than 404 unclaimed/holder_lapsed is retried at every later reminder (:280); the approved spec says it is logged and dropped. Either align the code or record the departure.
Acceptance bullet 6 names both removed states; only quiet is tested on either host. Add text-call cases (pi-legion and claude-envoy).

Security[secret] hardening: under postgres a Claude role gets no OMP_SESSION_SQL_DSN_FILE pointer (:1074), so the shim exports the session database URL as OMP_SESSION_SQL_DSN into Claude Code and every command it runs. Keep the pointer for every role and set OMP_SESSION_STORAGE for Oh My Pi alone.

ClaudeSessionRefusal (:382) is harness-wide transcript recognition living in the pod renderer and built by inverting ResumeSession's error; cmd/legion/sessions.go depends on it. Move a transcript recognizer into claudelaunch and have ResumeSession use it.
The header says nothing in the daemon sets the four numbers; specs.go now forwards them from the daemon's environment.
